settings.hero_heading: For the good in every day.
settings.hero_body: The first chai. The afternoon pause. Discover gur made for the moments that make a day yours.
settings.intro_heading: The little rituals stay with us.
settings.intro_body: Chai has a way of bringing us together. Green tea can give us a moment to ourselves. We began Talwar Organics with gur because one familiar sweetness has a place in both.
settings.rituals_kicker: TWO WAYS TO MAKE A MOMENT
settings.rituals_heading: From the first cup to the quiet one.
settings.rituals_body: Different parts of the day. A simple pleasure in each.
settings.chai_body: Stir plain gur into chai in place of sugar. Start with a little, then make it yours.
settings.tea_heading: A sweet bite for the slower hour.
settings.tea_body: Take a piece of dry fruit gur alongside green tea. Irregular, textured and satisfyingly sweet, just as the real pieces are.
settings.shop_body: Two ways to keep gur close: one for the cup, one for the pause.
settings.classic_card_body: The familiar sweetness for your everyday chai.
settings.dry_card_body: A sweet snack with texture, made to enjoy with green tea.
settings.close_heading: Make room for a little sweetness.
settings.close_body: Our first collection begins with gur. More good food for everyday moments will follow.
